results.title: Friends
results.overview: A young woman is worried: she feels that she has become... a foreign agent! She entered into correspondence with a representative of a foreign country! Well, how could she not respond when she received a message from... Ross from "Friends" – actor David Schwimmer from the popular TV show!

results.title: BTS Army: Forever We Are Young
results.original_title: BTS Army: Forever We Are Young
results.overview: From Seoul to Los Angeles, Texas to Mexico City, BTS ARMY is everywhere. FOREVER WE ARE YOUNG dives into the passionate fandom that catapulted 21st century pop icons BTS into a global household name. We meet fans at a BTS-focused ReactorCon in Lewisville, Texas, a dance instructor in Seoul who only teaches BTS choreography, and fans who’ve been organizing since 2013 to help BTS dominate the charts. Defying stereotypes of pop fans as screaming teen girls, ARMY is an intergenerational, culturally savvy, and socially active movement that is as diverse as the world itself.

results.title: Parah Bener
results.overview: A quartet of friends—Marko, Paing, Nacing, and Japri—constantly find themselves in trouble. One day, Marko witnesses his girlfriend, Marni, being abducted. Assisted by Japri, Marko sets off in pursuit of the kidnappers. Unfortunately, along the way, the pair are struck by a car driven by Tania, an up-and-coming celebrity who had reportedly run away from home. Overcome by guilt, Tania joins Japri and Marko in the chase to rescue Marni, with Paing and Nacing also tagging along. They eventually locate Marni in Anyer; however, instead of being pleased, Marni lashes out at Marko in anger.

results.title: Olivia
results.overview: Alone in the mountains: Olivia, her Father, and their home. By the foothills, a slaughterhouse, where Father works. When Father disappears Olivia descends the mountains in search of him.

results.title: Zizi (or Praying to a Fabulous Tree)
results.overview: Documentary and staged scenes mix in this very personal story of a family in the suburbs of Rio, through the memories of a backyard, a giant tree, and the woman who planted it.

results.title: Brier Hill
results.overview: In 1977 mafia-run Brier Hill, Youngstown, new lovers Benny and Taffy are driven by desperation into a spiral of vengeance and survival. As the streets close in, one irreversible choice seals their fate-and scars the neighborhood that raised them forever.

results.title: Kin Spirits
results.overview: A boozy, brilliant, locally notorious medium chases stardom, but her messy personal life hilariously derails her dreams of fame.

results.title: The End
results.overview: Anna needs to clean her room... Oh and the world is ending

results.title: Bolbol
results.overview: Bolbol tells the story of three generations of Iranian women under one roof in London. Maryam dedicates her life to care for her elderly mother Maman Joon who has dementia while simultaneously raising her teenage daughter Sadira who struggles with her Iranian-British identity.

results.title: Pakka
results.overview: Four gay Indian friends share an unbreakable bond on a Dutch cricket field. But when one agrees to an arranged marriage in India, their chosen family begins to unravel.

results.title: The Sphinx
results.overview: A locksmith’s date night becomes a waking nightmare.

results.title: (LIVE) BOY GEORGE AND CULTURE CLUB
results.overview: Few new wave groups were as popular as Culture Club. During the early '80s, the group racked up  seven straight Top Ten hits in the U.K. and six Top Ten singles in the U.S. with their light, infectious popsoul. Boy George and Culture Club are now on a US tour, after the recent release of their latest single  “How to Be a Chandelier”. Having delivered over tens of thousands of concerts all over the world, Boy  George and Culture Club will be performing for the first time ever LIVE to cinema audiences all over  the world in February 2023.

results.title: I Died in Irpin
results.overview: 24th February 2022, my boyfriend and I fled Kyiv to go to Irpin. We spent 10 days in a blockaded city and just managed to escape with the last evacuation convoy. Time passed, but the feeling that I died in Irpin has never left me since.

results.title: Welcome to Lynchland
results.original_title: David Lynch, une énigme à Hollywood
results.overview: Creator of absolute freedom, David Lynch constructed his work as an enigma to be deciphered between dream and reality. A cult director from his first films ("Eraserhead", "Elephant Man", "Blue Velvet"), Lynch forever changed the world of television with his series "Twin Peaks", before tackling the lies of Hollywood in "Mulholland Drive". Tracing the life of the most influential filmmaker of his generation, this documentary explores the hidden meaning of a relentlessly consistent filmography and delves beneath the dark, teeming surface of the American Dream.

results.title: Jarek
results.overview: The documentary explores the life and work of Jaromír Nohavica, utilizing hundreds of hours of his archive footage (including previously unreleased material). It offers a glimpse into his personal life, family background, concert dressing rooms, psychiatric clinic, and interrogation rooms of the former secret police (StB). The film is full of emotion, poetry, and harsh confrontations with reality, also reflecting the controversies surrounding Nohavica.

results.title: strikethrough 48
results.overview: strikethrough 48 is an erasure poetry film about ending one’s life in a country flooding with natural beauty but drought-ridden when it comes to services for the mentally ill. Inspired by a county north of the Golden Gate Bridge labeled "paradise on earth", it draws attention to the mosaic of invisible struggles that plagues its people and has left them paralyzed in their efforts to find a rainbow in the fog. Its "drawn-onfilm" technique allows the viewer to be immersed in the cinematic aspects of the poem, which, created by the erasure of a previous text, highlight the beauty of few words floating on a painted sea. strikethrough 48 is one of the most recent erasure poems from my choreographic poetry archive strikethrough-score.org (ca. 2020), whose purpose is not only to encourage the writing of poetry using a digital algorithm, but the cross-pollination of poetry with other art forms.

results.title: Dead Man's Switch
results.overview: Dalia discovers that her husband has vanished without a trace. As her life and her job as a subway driver begin to collapse, the violent indifference of her environment engulfs her in a dark tunnel that seems to lead nowhere.

results.title: Molt
results.overview: Consumed by an internet conspiracy about a sinister, unseen entity, a journalist grows increasingly convinced the threat is real. As his investigation deepens, he loses his grip on reality and spirals into paranoia. Ignoring his roommate’s warnings, he turns to a fringe parapsychologist who feeds his obsession. He doesn’t know if he’s closing in on the ominous presence—or if it’s hunting him.

results.title: Hazel's Heart
results.overview: In March of 1920, just outside of Center, North Dakota, Hazel Miner and her two siblings – Emmet and Myrdith – are getting ready to leave school. The students have been sent home early as the weather has started to turn from a gentle snowfall to what looks like it could be a terrible snowstorm. The siblings struggle through the wind and snow, and their sled overturns into a coulee and the three take shelter to try and survive the night. As they fight to stay warm and awake, their parents and friends work furiously to try and find them before it’s too late.

results.title: Sariri
results.overview: In La Lágrima, a desertic mining lost town, women live under the strict rules of patriarchy. Dina (16), pressed by an unwanted pregnancy, plans to escape. But when she finds out her sister Sariri (11), has to initiate womanhood after the arrival of her menarche, she’ll have to decide if they’ll escape together through the desert.
